summary: Make corpus decisions traceable before quality filtering and scale obscure their origins.
outcomes: Track provenance and permitted uses through transformations
Design removal, contamination and sensitive-data checks
sequence: Inventory source records and acquisition context
Separate legal permissions from technical accessibility
Check benchmark overlap and sensitive fields
Version the manifest and removal procedure

visual.question: Can a removed source still survive in transformed training shards?
visual.interaction: Follow source identifiers through deduplication and chunking

practice.task: Build a manifest for a small openly usable corpus
practice.success: Each shard has traceable source records, transformation versions and stated use boundaries
